items.title: Add evidence artifact/repro/admissibility directory entrypoints
items.context: Create the recommended source directories with public re-export modules over the existing implementation so new code can depend on stable paths without breaking old imports.
items.userSees: 开发者可以从 packages/main/src/core/evidence/artifact、evidence/repro、evidence/admissibility、evidence/storage 导入公共 API；旧的 core/proof-admissibility、core/repro-intake、core/evidence/artifact-store 路径仍然编译通过。

happy.desc: New evidence artifact/repro/admissibility/storage entrypoints compile and expose the same core symbols as legacy paths.

edge.desc: Legacy import paths continue to compile after new entrypoints are added.

adversarial.desc: New entrypoints do not copy proof registries or create competing definitions; smoke checks representative symbols are shared.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke imported evidence/artifact, evidence/storage, evidence/repro, and evidence/admissibility entrypoints and verified representative exports share identity with legacy artifact-store, repro-intake, and proof-admissibility modules.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/proof-admissibility-smoke.js && node packages/main/dist/tasks/repro-first-candidate-smoke.js
verificationEvidence.note: Build plus existing proof-admissibility and repro-first smokes passed, proving legacy paths still compile and behavior remains compatible.

Smoke asserts shared object/function identity for PROOF_SURFACE_REGISTRY, evaluateProofAdmissibility, createProbe, createStoryFromRepro, writeArtifact, and readArtifact, catching duplicated registries or copied implementations.

items.title: Add lifecycle-control skeleton and control status types
items.context: Create lifecycle-control/runtime, consumption, queue, and dashboard entrypoints with shared status types only. This story should not implement full global_control_status behavior or new gates.
items.userSees: 开发者可以从 packages/main/src/core/lifecycle-control 导入 StoryControlStatus、ProjectControlStatus、ControlPlaneCapabilities 和 runtime/consumption/queue/dashboard projection entrypoints；这些模块只提供只读类型/骨架，不注册 CLI 命令、不写 evidence、不改变 gate。

happy.desc: Lifecycle-control public types and projection entrypoints compile from the documented paths.

edge.desc: Skeleton modules remain read-only and contain no CLI registration or lifecycle mutation behavior.

adversarial.desc: Consumption projection types do not import concrete proof verifiers or write AdmissibilityEvaluationRow.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke imports lifecycle-control/index, control-status, global-control-service, runtime, consumption, queue, and dashboard namespaces and constructs StoryControlStatus and ProjectControlStatus through the public helpers.

Smoke verifies DEFAULT_CONTROL_PLANE_CAPABILITIES keeps commandRegistration, lifecycleGateMutation, evidenceWrites, authorityProductionSemantics, proofM7Enforcement, queueCleanupEnforcement, and tierCCleanup false.
Review check confirmed CP-5A is Runtime Enforcement only and proof/Authority-facing proof-consumer enforcement remains owned by Proof Admissibility; smoke verifies CP-5A/CP-5B split.

items.title: Exercise new module paths with focused smoke coverage
items.context: Add or update focused smoke imports so build/test proves the new paths compile while legacy paths remain compatible.
items.userSees: 运行 npm --prefix packages/main run build、node packages/main/dist/tasks/source-structure-convergence-smoke.js、proof-admissibility smoke、repro-first smoke 后都通过；输出明确说明 source-structure convergence smoke passed。

happy.desc: Focused source-structure smoke passes after build.

edge.desc: Existing proof-admissibility and repro-first smokes still pass, proving compatibility paths were not broken.

adversarial.desc: Smoke asserts new and legacy imports resolve to the same representative symbols, catching accidental duplicate registries.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke printed source-structure convergence smoke passed.
Existing proof-admissibility and repro-first smokes passed, proving compatibility paths did not break current behavior.
Smoke asserts representative identity between new and legacy imports, catching accidental duplicate registries/functions.
